summary.en-US: Capture and consolidate live chat from supported streaming and social platforms.

privacy_policy.en-US: Social Stream Ninja processes and may transmit authentication information, live chat and other personal communications, visible website content, usernames, display names, avatars, and related profile data to provide chat capture, relay, overlays, and integrations configured by the user. Data may be sent to connected platforms, Social Stream Ninja helper services, VDO.Ninja or WebRTC transport services, and destinations explicitly configured by the user. Social Stream Ninja does not sell user data, and most settings and working data are stored locally. The full privacy policy is available at https://socialstream.ninja/privacy.html.
